summary: A true caution yellow, a lighter web app on phones, and stronger security

groups.title: Colour and brand
items: Caution is now a true yellow everywhere. On light pages it is a yellow mark beside dark words, never mistaken for gold or green.
Caution never looks louder than danger.
Warning orange and the companion's colours read clearly on every background.
The tab icon on high-resolution screens is drawn pixel by pixel, so the mask's eyes show.

groups.title: Speed
items: Phones opening the web app no longer download the 3D mask and model list they never show, about 540 KB less per visit.
The computer app shows its main content sooner.

groups.title: Live scanning
items: Marks fooled by a repaint slide back in under a second and stay visible.

groups.title: Security
items: Passwords set from now on need 15 characters. A few unrelated words work well. Existing passwords keep working.
The Windows app release build shuts more ways other programs could misuse it.
The browser companion checks who sends every message.

groups.title: Settings
items: Settings tells you once when another device's newer choice replaced yours.
